description: This PHP source file implements a web page for configuring Wi-Fi network settings as part of a home network wizard. It includes server-side logic for retrieving current Wi-Fi settings, client-side JavaScript for form validation and dynamic UI behavior, and HTML form elements for user input.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the Wi-Fi configuration data to the server via AJAX for saving.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, constructs a JSON configuration string, and calls set_config to save Wi-Fi settings.
